## Type of change

- [ ] Schema text: changes what the data schema says, such as a name, definition, type, value, structure or example
- [ ] Editorial: corrects the text without changing what the data schema says, such as a typo or a broken link
- [ ] Repository only: documentation, supporting material, templates, tools or workflows
